profile.headline: Software Engineer I @ Truist Bank
profile.summary:
Motivated, independent, and passionate information technology graduate with a strong
interest in computer security and networking having multitasking, problem-solving and collaboration
skills.

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description:
- Develop and support enterprise-level mainframe solutions for the ACH Bank-Core Payments team, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in processing the majority of the bank’s money movement.

- Hands-on experience in COBOL, JCL (including JCL Sorts), DB2, CICS, SQL, and mainframe utilities such as VSAM, IDCAMS, SPUFI, File Manager, Easytrieve, and ChangeMan.

- Provide support in batch processing while maintaining compliance with NACHA regulatory standards.

-  Collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance solutions that drive daily financial operations.

- Contribute to large-scale data migration and modernization initiatives, enhancing the reliability and   efficiency of core payment systems.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.insights: Agile Project Management, SQL and +6 skills

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Implemented and designed matrix system for each company’s product using seller cloud service
•	Ensuring the data delivered to the front end / user interface is accurate and displaying it using the given schema by the company according to the company’s standard.
•	Solving data-related issues for a better user experience
•	Organize and group products based on various categories to make the website visually appealing
•	Review product names and descriptions for any errors
positions.insights: Critical Thinking, Project Planning and +8 skills
